\title{Attention Is All You Need for Mini Batches}
\author{A. Vaswani \and N. Shazeer}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
We study a compact sequence model that uses only attention blocks.
\end{abstract}
\begin{IEEEkeywords}
transformer, attention, sequence modeling
\end{IEEEkeywords}
\section{Introduction}
Attention-only architectures reduce path length and improve parallelism.
We evaluate small machine translation tasks and report latency.
\section{Method}
Given tokens $x_1,\dots,x_n$, self-attention computes
\begin{equation}
\mathrm{Attn}(Q,K,V)=\mathrm{softmax}\left(\frac{QK^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}}\right)V.
\end{equation}
\section{Conclusion}
The model remains competitive while reducing engineering complexity.
